author: siiir9
quote: GTA VI turns a crime romance into a trust exercise. Rockstar sold me on two outlaws who would risk everything for each other. What I got was a relationship that spends too much time teasing betrayal and too little time showing why either of them should trust the **** problem with the feminist messaging is how unevenly the game writes its leads. Lucia gets to keep secrets and push boundaries, while Jason is expected to keep proving he’s a good partner. That double standard makes him look like a doormat and makes her harder to root for. The story can get that reaction without ever showing a full-blown **** worst part? The game gives me a system for keeping their romance alive while the writing gives me fewer and fewer reasons to bother.
